description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage construction technology team as its founding applied AI engineer. You will build the intelligence layer behind tools that interpret construction blueprints and support faster, more efficient project estimation, with a focus on turning computer vision and AI research into useful prototypes.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop and improve computer vision, machine learning, and AI systems, focusing on the intelligence layer rather than the application layer.

 - Evaluate and apply current computer vision models, large language models, and other AI approaches to challenging construction data problems.

 - Build and ship initial prototypes quickly, then refine them using feedback from users.

 - Contribute pragmatically to early-stage product work beyond core modeling when needed.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on applied computer vision and machine learning experience, including Python and deep learning; candidates across experience levels are considered, from 0 to 10+ years.

 - Experience taking an AI system from an initial concept to production deployment.

 - Strong problem-solving ability, a growth mindset, and comfort tackling ambiguous challenges and practical early-stage work.

 - Clear, empathetic, and candid communication, including openness about what is and is not working.

 - Motivation to help make housing more affordable through improved construction workflows.

 - Construction or social-impact experience is helpful, as is having built a product or tool that people adopted or paid for.

 - Must be a US citizen and able to work full-time in the San Francisco office or relocate.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Salary range: $120,000 to $180,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, United States. Full-time office attendance is expected.
